# Mathematics belongs in the document

Keep explanatory prose and LaTeX-style formulas together. Inline scripts such
as $x_k^7$ stay beside the text they explain.

## Fractions and roots

$$
\frac{17}{3} + \sqrt{17}
$$

## Align related equations

$$
\begin{aligned}a&=17\\longname&=3\end{aligned}
$$

## Preserve matrix structure

$$
\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&7\end{bmatrix}
$$

Supported math renders inside the native document workflow, alongside text,
code and diagrams.
